data.description:
Replace the ~300 lines of if/elif pattern matching with expr calls.

Changes:
1. query() method calls natural language translator
2. Translator converts to expr syntax
3. Execute via expr infrastructure
4. Add deprecation warning to CLI
5. Eventually remove legacy code

Files to modify:
- scripts/got_utils.py (query method at lines 2392-2693)
- cortical/got/cli/query.py

Depends on: Natural language translator complete

properties.retrospective: Replaced 300-line if/elif pattern matching with translator pipeline (translate → parse → execute). 85% code reduction. 41 behavioral tests pass. Alpha software - no backward compatibility concerns.

data.title: Deprecate legacy query command, make it wrapper for expr
